5770.title: [M157] Adopt upstream subset-clamping and filter-cache fixes
5770.body:
[M157] Adopt upstream subset-clamping and filter-cache fixes (#5770)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/459
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5778

Advance release/4.157.x to the landed mono/skia merge
51cb594d773b5383a45065ea3c8cbec398ad2c36 and record upstream chrome/m157
commit aa9f1d23fa91f2557922e6d527d2378f0838adc1 in cgmanifest.json.
Keep the native gitlink and component registration aligned with the actual
merge commit, not the pre-merge review head. The landed native commit has
two parents, directly contains reviewed head
74062f5aac6764114a2eaefd5078f40bc1fb4a07, and has the identical tree.

~~ Preserve image subsets under AA and MSAA ~~

Adopt the upstream correction for texture-coordinate extrapolation beyond
image subsets under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA.
One-pixel filter padding alone cannot contain that expansion. The native
change retains logical proxy bounds for approximate-fit textures and
requires strict sampling constraints where transparent borders are
consumed, preventing unrelated backing-store texels from leaking into
filtered images.

~~ Match image-filter cache equality to hashing ~~

Adopt bytewise image-filter cache-key equality to match the existing hash
over the key representation. Numerical matrix equality did not distinguish
signed-zero representations or cached type masks, and subnormal comparisons
can depend on floating-point mode. The upstream correction keeps equality
and hashing consistent, including colliding keys and LRU eviction.

This same-milestone sync changes only the native gitlink and provenance
manifest. Package versions, public managed APIs and the C API remain
unchanged. Independent regeneration matched the five maintained binding
groups before the tree-identical native landing was repinned.

5748.title: [M157] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening
5748.body:
[M157] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening (#5748)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/455
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5755
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/ee5ff28274c8cd3f637f26cf9eed88a8cff1d96e...4c6bb29f2d638cbc60528c84e54f6a777a474a07

Bring Google's mask-filtered SkScalerContext::getImage hardening into
release/4.157.x. Consecutive glyph loads can disagree in outline availability,
format, or bounds; the native update handles those differences without
changing managed wrappers, generated bindings, or milestone identity.

~~ Rasterize the reloaded glyph rather than stale outline state ~~

Mask filtering regenerates an unfiltered glyph with a second makeGlyph call,
but path rendering inspected the first glyph's path and format. Divergent
loads could hit the unsupported ARGB32 path assertion or rasterize a stale
outline into the new glyph bounds.

Inspect and rasterize unfilteredGlyph's own path through
generateImageFromPath, falling back to generateImage when it has no path.
The native regression cases exercise outline/raster transitions in both
directions and changed outlines with overlapping bounds.

~~ Reject incompatible masks before byte-per-pixel copies ~~

The filtered-overlap copy assumed matching byte-per-pixel formats. A
second load returning a 1-bit mask could copy 64 bytes into an 8-byte row;
mismatched filter output could instead terminate on a release assertion.

Require matching A8, 3D, or SDF formats before copying, clearing the
destination for incompatible formats or non-overlapping bounds. Native
regressions check zeroed output for sub-byte and mismatched emboss masks.

The earlier bounds guard and its regression test remain present. Those
two files came from one Google change,
fef85164f8f030f886f411d81bca95b50dbddcdf, previously inherited through the
m156 backport. The new m157 upstream baseline contains that fix, so its
disappearance from the fork delta is convergence, not lost fork-authored work.

~~ Preserve full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs ~~

Multiplying the clipped row count by three ignored the original full-image
stride between k3D planes. Clearing height * rowBytes also left the
multiply and add planes dirty.

Capture full plane strides before clipping, clear origGlyph.imageSize,
and copy each plane's overlap separately. Native regression cases check
cleared clipped rows in the three embossed planes, retained alpha/multiply
overlap, and nonzero SDF overlap with clipped columns cleared.

~~ Record landed native ancestry without changing reviewed content ~~

Update externals/skia and its Component Governance registration from
ee5ff28274c8cd3f637f26cf9eed88a8cff1d96e to the actual native merge,
4c6bb29f2d638cbc60528c84e54f6a777a474a07. Record upstream chrome/m157 at
7edab85755a05bd01372693b7fbfa7ac401c9760 while retaining milestone 157.

The native merge has two parents and directly contains reviewed head
8dca124f83a0f1b164933a1231f0ba1ee9a10021. Both have tree
42fefc6114c82dbd1030295a6d1c7371e3158d42. Dependent repin #5755 changed
only the gitlink and matching manifest SHA, preserving the reviewed source.

Required CI build 1681743 succeeded for the pre-repin parent head.
Tree equality preserves the accepted native-source and binding-regeneration
evidence; it is not an additional execution test of the glyph regressions.

5727.title: Fix OpenJDK validation with JVM diagnostics and task retries
5727.body:
Match javac's version at the start of any output line so JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS diagnostics do not reject a valid JDK. Keep exit-code and requested-major validation unchanged, and overwrite archive files on retry after a complete or partial extraction.
